history_summary: Add the Pseudoduganella rivuli species-reference GTDB correspondence
history_details: Preserve FT92W/KACC 21474 as the cultured isolate and its distinction from the network Duganella ASV, the four-isolate treatment versus Chlorella-amended treatment, all existing other GTDB blocks and the eukaryotic no-equivalent state. Native species-ID correspondence has three reference genomes/fraction 1.0; no exact-stock assembly or BioSample-to-GTDB membership is newly certified. Only taxonomy[2]'s GTDB block/status and two native inline events changed. Historical mapping notes, source quotations and all biological claims remain unchanged. Scoped database and provenance correction, not full scientific approval or corpus QC.
